mapper.sql: select id, product_id, merchant_id, image_type, image_url, sort_order, sku_value, status, create_time, update_time from product_image
mapper.select: where product_id = #{productId} and status = 1 order by sort_order asc, create_time asc
mapper.insert: insert into product_image ( product_id, merchant_id, image_type, image_url, sort_order, sku_value, status, create_by, create_time ) values ( #{productId}, #{merchantId}, #{imageType}, #{imageUrl}, #{sortOrder}, #{skuValue}, #{status}, #{createBy}, sysdate() )
mapper.update: update product_image set status = 0 where id = #{id}
update product_image set status = 0 where product_id = #{productId}
